properties.name: Every command that fronts a skill is a thin pointer, so an installed copy cannot go stale
properties.rationale: The v0.83.3 fix for /capture-session (#731, 4fc5449e8, 2026-10-12) never reached the installed copies. On 2026-10-24, ~/.claude/commands/capture-session.md (dated 2026-08-23) and dev_reflow2's copy (dated 2026-08-14) still held "what dies with the session is the reasoning", with reflow2 at 0.84.0 and later releases out, and /design-a-proof and /design-an-argument had reached neither. A new binary re-copies no installed command. The premise that let commands ship, "four lines that name a skill ... nothing that goes stale", was false: 22 commits on main changed getting-started/commands/ from 2026-08-14 to 2026-10-23, and commands ran 6 to 17 lines. In Claude Code the old text ran 32 times from 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-24 and was stopped 4 times by the reasoning_extraction classifier (first reply on 09-22, 10-01 and 10-24; partway on 10-03). The cause corrected is that a command held version-coupled text. The lint pins the class, not the one sentence. Anthony chose the thin-pointer fix on 2026-10-24. The correction to the cause is recorded on fact:recurrence-capture-session-in-vs-code-is-declined-by-the-models-refusal-stop-not-a-service-failure-2026-10-12. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Every command in getting-started/commands/ that names a skill now holds only its frontmatter, the one sentence naming the skill (with the word's tag for /note and /log-issue), and its closing input label and $ARGUMENTS. Every other line moved verbatim into the skill it fronts, under "## When it is run as /<command>", for 36 commands across 33 skills (jot has one section per word). /debt, /decisions and /next have no served skill and are the lint's listed exception. /adopt and /genesis keep the pinned paragraph for a directory with no design yet. tools/skill_lint.py gains thick_command_lines and the check "every command that names a skill is a thin pointer". It was observed failing on all 36 commands before the thinning, and passing after. tools/test_skill_lint.py adds 13 tests, including the exception set against COMMAND_ALIASES and check_command_surface.py. The reasoning-extraction comment (skill_lint.py) and the TREES comment (reflow2_init.py) are corrected. The served instructions gain a paragraph on naming a choice's justification rather than an agent's own reasoning. The MCP-install golden is re-blessed: only the 36 command files and the receipt moved.
